title: Kaizen codebase-index entry
description: One row in the codebase semantic index at <repo>/.kaizen/onboard.db. Produced + consumed by skills/kaizen/scripts/onboard_index.py. One row per source file after comment-stripping + whitespace normalization.

path.description: Path relative to the project root.

sloc.description: Source-line count after comment-strip + blank-line collapse.

snippet.description: First ~2KB of cleaned content for display. Embedding is computed over the full cleaned content (truncated by the model).

sha.description: 16-hex SHA1 prefix of raw file content. Used for change detection on re-index.

id.description: SQLite primary key. Null before insert.

score.description: Cosine similarity score. Only present in do_search results.
